testCases: simultaneous creates reserve capacity atomically before provider startup
live provider runtimes continue to consume capacity after entering an error state
provider startup and registration failures release reserved capacity
registration failures close and remove partially installed provider runtimes
closing and timed-out reload runtimes stay charged until provider close succeeds
failed provider cleanup remains conservatively charged
resume, import, reload, and stored-agent recovery share one admission boundary
shutdown waits for in-flight registration and releases its reservation
the optional daemon limit accepts positive integers and remains unbounded when omitted
the generated public JSON schema accepts the positive runtime limit and rejects zero

commands: npx vitest run src/server/agent/agent-manager.test.ts src/server/agent/agent-loading.test.ts src/server/persisted-config.test.ts src/server/config.test.ts --bail=1

patches.upstreamCondition: Submit while the stable daemon has no host-local atomic admission limit for live agent provider runtimes.
patches.dropCondition: Remove when the latest stable release provides equivalent configurable atomic admission across create, resume, import, reload, and recovery while counting actual live provider runtimes and cleaning up all startup failure paths.
